name: Alfred (Bat Cave)
description: A voice skin built on the Bat Cave bat. The bat glows with the spoken words, two traces spike out from its wings with the speech like an oscilloscope, a heartbeat travels out while the assistant thinks, and the bat spins like the 1966 scene change when the command completes and when the overlay closes.
author: Adam Hopkins

settings.title: Label under the bat
settings.description: Shown in small tracked capitals under the bat and lit while the assistant answers. Leave empty for no label.

settings.title: Trace height
settings.description: How far the two voice traces spike from the bat's wings.

settings.title: Bat color
settings.description: The bat, its glow and the rings of the spin. Left at the default, the bat is Bat Cave blue and a deeper blue under the Light theme.

settings.title: Trace color
settings.description: The two voice traces. Left at the default, they are Bat Cave blue and a deeper blue under the Light theme.

settings.title: Text color
settings.description: The answer, what you said and the label under the bat. Left at the default, the text is near white under the Dark theme and near black under the Light theme, and the lit label takes the bat's color.

settings.title: Bat spin
settings.description: The 1966 Batman spin: after the assistant finishes speaking, and when the overlay closes.
